limitations: Transport browser checks used real loopback HTTP receivers. External SMTP and Apprise providers, mobile push and the independent watchdog were not exercised in this fixture.
Cross-organization authorization, stale-reader rejection, expiry and queue/evidence-store fault injection are additionally covered by API, component and notification runtime regressions.

The generic fixture restart helper has a ten-second termination cutoff. The graceful-restart check instead waited for the task-owned process to exit and required NotificationManager stopped and Server stopped log witnesses before invoking the helper.
